facts.fact: The Data for Health 2025 annual report says UBOS completed Uganda's first Annual Vital Statistics Report with cause-of-death analysis, reviewed by NIRA and pending dissemination after executive approval.

The report says the first Annual Vital Statistics Report, completed by UBOS, rests on cause-of-death analysis of death notification and medical certification data from health facilities, in a pipeline with NIRA.

UGA.note: The DHIS2-to-NIRA link is health notification to the civil register, not stated as a civil register to ID system link.

facts.fact: The report says that in late 2025 the Ministry of Health and NIRA developed digital birth and death registers enabling transfer of notifications from DHIS2 to NIRA's CRVS systems.
facts.system: digital birth and death registers (MoH and NIRA)

systems.country_label: MoH-NIRA digital birth and death registers

UGA.note: Document states nothing on public digital skills.

facts.fact: The report says EMR systems were rolled out rapidly in 2025, though without synchronised integration of the MCCD and death notification modules.
The report says the move to digital systems created a reporting gap in 2025, as paper tools were phased out while not all health facilities are yet covered by digital platforms.

UGA.note: DHIS2 is named only for death notification and MCCD reports; no statement of national routine reporting or a link to a separate health system.
Nothing on who operates the ID system.
No register keyed on the ID number stated.
Nothing on the national ID system itself.
Consultations named concern a medical curriculum and mortality guidelines, not a digital law or policy.
